audience: insurance brokers and agency staff who manage cases, contacts and tasks in NextAgency

useCases.title: Review cases by sales status
useCases.text: List the cases with a sales status, such as Prospect or Client, one page at a time. Open one case to read its stage, owner and addresses.

useCases.title: Find a contact by name, email or phone number
useCases.text: Search the contacts by name or email, or find the contacts that use a phone number. Open one contact to read its emails, phone numbers and addresses.

useCases.title: Check the tasks and notes of a case
useCases.text: List the tasks of a case with their stage, due date and assignees. Read the notes of the case, including the full text of one note.

useCases.title: Review the employees and benefits of a case
useCases.text: List the employees and insurance benefits of one case, with pay cycles and policy types. Social security numbers are removed from the record fields.

useCases.title: Open a case with a note and a task
useCases.text: Create a case with a name, then add a note with the context. Add a task for a user, using the user id from the user list.
